causal-factors.name: Near-threshold headroom to 7,145,000 (approx. 7,143,993 as of Feb 2026)
causal-factors.rationale: The count is only about 1,007 articles shy of the 7,145,000 target as of February 2026, and recent monthly growth suggests crossing the threshold could occur by March 1, 2026.

causal-factors.name: Sustained near-term growth rate for English Wikipedia
causal-factors.rationale: From mid-2025 to February 2026, English Wikipedia added a substantial number of articles, implying continued progress into early March 2026.

causal-factors.name: Milestones and credible reporting signals momentum
causal-factors.rationale: Milestones such as the 7,000,000+ article mark in 2025 and corroborating reporting indicate ongoing expansion and momentum.

causal-factors.name: Risk of growth slowdown as the count nears a large milestone
causal-factors.rationale: Growth rates often slow as the total approaches very large milestones, introducing a non-negligible risk of not crossing exactly at the target date.

causal-factors.name: Momentum of English Wikipedia growth following the 7 million milestone
causal-factors.rationale: Late-2025 counts place English Wikipedia around 7.0–7.15 million, suggesting continued additions could push to 7.145 million by March 1, 2026.

causal-factors.name: Risk of decelerating growth rate in late 2025 into 2026
causal-factors.rationale: Growth rates appeared to slow toward the end of 2025, which would reduce the incremental articles needed to reach the target.

causal-factors.name: Inter-source variability in article-count reporting
causal-factors.rationale: Different sources use varying counting conventions and cutoffs, which can produce small discrepancies in the exact total.

causal-factors.name: Event-driven surges from major world events or anniversaries
causal-factors.rationale: Major events historically trigger bursts of new or updated English Wikipedia articles, providing short-term upward pressure.

causal-factors.name: Editorial capacity and platform/policy constraints
causal-factors.rationale: Limits on editor time, funding, or policy changes could constrain the rate of new article creation.

causal-factors.name: Continued near-term growth of the English Wikipedia article count
causal-factors.rationale: Milestones show sustained growth: English Wikipedia surpassed seven million articles on May 28, 2025, and reports through late 2025 and early 2026 indicate counts near 7 million and trending upward, which supports a non-negligible chance of reaching 7,145,000 by March 1, 2026. (Sources: The English Wikipedia milestone 7 million on May 28, 2025; Pew Research Center reporting around 7 million English-language articles by December 2025; Tom's Hardware noting English counts above 7 million by January 2026.)

causal-factors.name: Small remaining gap to 7,145,000 in the March 1, 2026 window
causal-factors.rationale: If English Wikipedia articles continue to grow at the recent pace into early 2026, the modest gap to 7,145,000 could be closed within the remaining days before March 1, 2026, given the observed near-term momentum around late 2025. (Sources: Milestone 7M in 2025; late-2025 / early-2026 reporting of near-7M English articles.)

causal-factors.name: Editorial/community engagement risk could dampen near-term growth
causal-factors.rationale: The project relies on a large volunteer base (hundreds of thousands of editors); any fatigue, resource constraints, or policy shifts could slow the rate of new article creation, modestly reducing the probability of hitting the exact threshold in the short window. (Source: Wikimedia Foundation notes about a large, active editor base of ~250,000 and ongoing editing activity.)

synthesis: The near-term trajectory for English Wikipedia suggests a real, though not guaranteed, chance of exceeding 7,145,000 by March 1, 2026. With momentum and near-threshold headroom, a calibrated probability of about 0.82 captures the upside while acknowledging measurement and pacing uncertainties.
